claims.head: The Red Wings’ power play is a weapon
claims.body: On the power play, Detroit is one of the league’s best, but Calgary is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Every penalty the Flames take could cost them.

notes.text: Simon Edvinsson has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Ben Chiarot has taken his spot beside Moritz Seider.
Michal Postava was added to the roster on Oct 23.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 9 games cover only 31% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 7th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Samuel Honzek is on injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 5 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Joel Hanley has not dressed for the last 7 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters. Jake Middleton has taken his spot beside Zayne Parekh.
Connor Zary has not dressed for the last 6 games.
Jonathan Huberdeau is on injured reserve (hip surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward.
Ben Jones was added to the roster on Oct 21 and has played beside Joel Farabee and Matt Coronato.
Martin Pospíšil has started killing penalties: on the ice for 32% of the team’s shorthanded time in 9 games, up from 2% last season.

CGY.head: The Flames have a hill to climb
CGY.body: Even though Calgary has home-ice advantage, Detroit has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Flames can pull it off if they keep dangerous shots away.

DET.head: The matchup suits the Red Wings
DET.body: Even though Calgary has home-ice advantage, Detroit has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Flames can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: Who’s in net for the Red Wings?
paras: The Flames have won two in a row. The Red Wings are 4-3-3.
The Red Wings shoot a lot, and the Flames give up plenty. The Wings’ power play bites, but the Flames’ doesn’t.
